name: Stay Permit + Foreign Registration Certificate (employer-sponsored)

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsoring employer (an MIC-permitted investor, its affiliated group companies, or a registered Myanmar company) must confirm the employment and provide an invitation letter with a copy of the company's registration certificate.
Applies to foreign employees remaining in Myanmar beyond the initial 90-day business-visa stay, who must convert to a Stay Permit and obtain a Foreign Registration Certificate (FRC).

evidence_required.document: Employer invitation letter + company registration certificate copy
Stay Permit application (via employer's One Stop Service Center where applicable)

outcome.duration_length: Business Visa base: 3 months validity / 70 days stay; Multiple Journey Special Re-entry Visa (MJSRV): first grant 6 months, subsequent grants 12 months; Stay Permit/FRC renewable alongside employment

sources.title: Thilawa Special Economic Zone Management Committee, Myanmar (government body operating under the Ministry of Investment / MIC framework) -- Visa and Immigration: describes Stay Permit, Foreign Registration Certificate (FRC), and Multiple Journey Special Re-entry Visa (MJSRV, first grant 6 months, subsequent grants 12 months) for employees of MIC-permitted investors and their affiliated group companies, processed through the SEZ's One Stop Service Center

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Myanmar). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced, though specifically from a Special Economic Zone (Thilawa) management committee page rather than a general national Ministry of Labour/Immigration page -- the SEZ's One Stop Service Center process is the clearest documented version of this mechanism found in this build, and it is understood to mirror the general national Stay Permit/FRC system used for foreign employees outside SEZs, but this generalization is not independently tier-1 confirmed outside the SEZ context, so treat SEZ-specific procedural details (e.g. 'One Stop Service Center') as illustrative of the broader mechanism rather than guaranteed identical nationwide. No distinct labour-market test or minimum-salary threshold was found at tier-1; work_rights is 'restricted' since the permit ties the holder to the sponsoring employer/investor. Political-context caveat in mm_visitor_visa.json applies equally here -- foreign employment in Myanmar since 2021 also carries meaningful sanctions-compliance risk for companies from jurisdictions (US/EU/UK and others) that have imposed targeted sanctions on Myanmar military-linked entities; this dataset does not model sanctions exposure, which is a separate legal question from the immigration mechanics captured here.
